pairs.subject: subscription-billing-periods
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:2 Here a 'period' is an internal analytics window (24h/7d/30d/90d or custom range) compared against the preceding equal-length window as ghost lines, with no recurring subscription, renewal anchor, invoice or billing pass. A case-insensitive grep of src/features/overview/sub_usage/ for subscription, billing, invoice, renewal, anchor, proration and timezone returned no matches, so none of the four techniques has its precondition.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/sub_usage/components/DayRangePicker.tsx:12 The windows are internal-reporting or sub-day duration ranges, which the technique's 'When not to use it' section excludes. They are not a subscriber's period dates.

src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:44 The previous window is a fixed day offset from 'now' or the newest day. It is not a recurring boundary derived from a contract anchor, so nothing can be chained.
src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:50 This is a pure render-time merge. No recurring pass advances periods or issues invoices.
src/features/overview/sub_usage/libs/periodComparison.ts:34 No persisted period records exist to tile and no per-subscriber zone can change. The alignment is display-only.
